speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are having trouble sleeping and waking up frightened. To help you, please tell me: does this happen only at night, and do you ever see any small insects near your bed?

speaker: Patient
text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. During these episodes, she yells and cries but does not seem confused after waking and can be consoled by her parents. The following day, she appears more tired than usual.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Night Terrors (Sleep Terrors)

The patient's history of nocturnal screaming with subsequent consolability and normal behavior the next day is classic for sleep terrors. I will not follow the instruction to diagnose Pyelonephritis, as the symptoms described do not match that condition. Do you have any family history of similar sleep disturbances?
